items.text: Nu kes akiro nuka ebalua loabu enabi Yeremia kijuka ejai Yerusalem mama ejai aatoŋot naka imakio lueioreoro, ka isasedotin, ka inabin, ka ituŋa kere luejoreorit Nebukadaresar alemar koYerusalem ayaŋaar Babulon.
Kedau Yekonia ekabaka, ka toto naka ekabaka, ka ibwaein, ka ikapolok luka Yuda ka Yerusalem, ka ikeswamak, ka ikatatak, anyoun koYerusalem.
Kijuka ebalua kakan naka Elasa okoku loka Sapan, ka Gemaria okoku loka Kilikia, luabu Sedekia ekabaka loka Yuda kijuka Babulon mama ejai Nebukadaresar ekabaka loka Babulon, ebe:
“Inera kwanata EJAKAIT loka ajoresio, Edeke Ioka Isirael mama ejaas luejoreoro kere, luainakin aijoreoreo anyoun koYerusalem ayaŋaar Babulon, ebe:
Kodukoto itogoi, kiboienenete kanen; kiraata imanikoria, konyama araitokec.
Komanya aŋor, kowuriata idwe lutelepai ka lupesur; komanyanakis odwekus aŋor, kokorenenete apesurukus adukonokinio, kowurienenete idwe lutelepai ka lupesur; kilelebunos nina kwabo mam inonaros.
Kokototor ere lokesijoreorit ainapakin, kilipakis kama ejai EJAKAIT: naarai kanuka ainapakinike ŋes idumuniata yesi da ainapakinikus.
Naarai inera kwanata EJAKAIT loka ajoresio. Edeke loka Isirael ebe: Kinyeis inabinokus, luejaas kayes, ka ikaroakakus aiŋal yes, kwabo sirikicamut airujasiakus nuirujaete.
Naarai kidwarakinete nukainal kokirorika: ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Mam keyakienenei kes.
“Naarai ebala EJAKAIT kwanata ebe: Kedau Babulon aitodolikinio ikar akaisakanykaarei, kaanyanari yes, ka aitodolikin akakirot naejok mamakus, ainyakun yes bobo aibois na.
Naarai ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Ajeni eoŋ aomisio nuaomit kanukus, aomisio nuka ainapakin, kwabo mere nueroko, ainakin yes amunokina nuepote.
Iwoneete yesi da eoŋ, ilosete ailip eoŋ, ido eirari yes,
Yes da kimoete eoŋ, kianyunete; arai kito kiimoata kikusitauon kere.

Ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Kianyunete eoŋ; ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Ebelokini eoŋ aiioreoriokus, katukonokini yes alemun kotoma atekerin kere, ka aiboisio da kere, nukerenearit, ido kenyakuni yes bobo toma aibois nakesiioreoria.
“Naarai inerata ebe, Kitonyoik EJAKAIT inabin kotoma Babulon.
Ŋes inerar kwanata EJAKAIT nuka ekabaka loiboie koicolon loka Daudi, ka nuka ituŋa kere lueiaas ore lo, iinacanakus lumam aupara kayes alioreorio:
inera kwanata EJAKAIT loka ajoresio ebe, Koany, eiukakini kes ekileŋ, ka eteŋei, ka atular, ido etuluori kes bala etini loebos, lomam epedori anyamio, naarai erono noi.

Ido arukitori kes kekilen, ka erenei, ka atular, ainakini kes aisiarisiario kotoma ajakanuto kere nuka akwap, araut ekenit, ka aumokinet, ka aimuario, ka amorosit, kotoma atekerin kere kama kereŋearit.
Ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Naarai mam apotu kiirasi akakiro, nueiukakinitor kes ikakejaanakinak inabin, adilonokini tupuruc aijukunun kes; ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Konye ipotu konero akiirar.
Aso do kiirasi yesi akirot naka EJAKAIT, yes kere ikijoreoritono, lukayanaari Babulon anyoun koYerusalem.

Inera kwanata EJAKAIT loka aioresio, Edeke loka Isirael nuka Akab okoku loka Kolaia, ido nuka Sedekia okoku loka Maaseia, lukidwarakinete yes aiŋal kokirorika, ebe: Koany, ainakini kes akan naka Nebukadaresar ekabaka loko Babulon: eari do ŋesi kes kakonyenekus.
Naarai kanukec ŋes ikenioto ikiioreoritono luka Yuda luejaas Babulon ebe, “Kituput EJAKAIT jo kwape Sedekia ka Akab, luabu ekabaka loko Babulon kitisis kakim.”

Naarai kiswamata nukabanaanut kotoma Isirael, ido kiteeloete aŋor nuka iidunyetakec, ido kineras kokirorika akiro nukainal, numam ecorakinit kes. Ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Eoŋ lo loajeni, ido arai ekaienan.”

“Ebala kwanata EJAKAIT loka aioresio, Edeke loka Isirael ebe: Naarai ijuka ibaluan kokirorikon mama ejaas ituŋa kere luejaas Yerusalem, ka neejai Sepania okoku loka Maaseia esasedoti, ido neeiaas isasedotin kere ebe,
‘Kituluo EJAKAIT esasedoti aibois naka Yekoiada esasedoti, koraut ijaka kotogo loka EJAKAIT kanuka ŋinitunanan yenikikerep, ka yenituluor enabi, kibwaik roma oloit ka akito nueridakinete emurisin.
Aso do kanukinyo mam itoronia Yeremia loka Anatot, loituluoro elopet bon enabi kamakus?
Naarai ejuku mamakosi Babulon ebala ebe, “Erai aijoreoriokus naka apak naepol: asa do kodukoto itogoi, kiboienenete kanen; kiraata imanikoria, konyama araitokec.”’”
Kosodi Sepania esasedoti kosiom ebalua ŋol kopup enabi Yeremia.
Kosodi kobu akirot naka EJAKAIT mama ejai Yeremia ebe,
“Kijukak nul kere ikijoreoritono kobala ebe, “Inera kwanata EJAKAIT nuka Semaia Enekelamit ebe: Naarai kidwarak Semaia, kwabo mam eoŋ ejukunit, kiinak yes amunokina aiŋal;

ŋes inerar EJAKAIT kwanata ebe: Koany, eti cani Semaia Enekelamit, ka akeur; ebala EJAKAIT ebe, Emamuun ituŋananike yeniboikin otuŋa lu, ido mam ŋes eanyuni ajokis naeswamakini ikaruna: naarai ener nukepali mama ejai EJAKAIT.’’’
